client: confidential

  own plant.

text: Mina built an attrition and absence dashboard for our manufacturing team that helped us cover 1,900 employees and spot attrition hotspots in 2 plants. The dashboard was set up so each plant manager could only see their own plant, which was exactly what we needed. Work was solid overall, though communication could have been a bit quicker at times.
